description: TypeScript definition for the Comparator class used in semver package, defining version comparison logic.

classes.name: Comparator
classes.description: Class representing version comparators used for semantic versioning. Includes methods for parsing, testing, and intersecting version comparators.

methods.name: constructor(comp: string | Comparator, optionsOrLoose?: boolean | semver.Options); constructor
methods.description: Initializes a Comparator object with a comparison string or another Comparator, optionally with configuration options.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a comparison string to initialize the comparator.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests whether a given version satisfies the comparator.

methods.name: intersects
methods.description: Checks whether this comparator intersects with another comparator under given options.
